message.reasoning_content: The kernel drops the ReLU residual. Need to check whether over the box the residual (sum of relu terms) stays ≤ 1.0 for all legal x. Need to compute max over box. Residual max is bounded; worst case x = sign(W[j]) scaled... Actually per neuron: c[j]*max(dot(W,x)-b,0), max over x in box of dot(W,x) = sum|W[j,i]|. b = 0.75*sum|W|. So max per neuron = 0.25*sum|W[j]|, times c=0.25. Total residual max = 0.25*0.25*sum_j sum|W| = 0.0625*||W||_1. Each |W| entry is 0.5 or 1.0, 12 entries → sum|W[j]| between 6 and 12. Total across 6 neurons ≤ 0.0625*72 = 4.5, but each row ≤ 0.75*sum|W[j]| (b term)... max residual per neuron = 0.25*0.25*sum|W[j]| = up to 0.75 per neuron; total up to 4.5 > 1.0 potentially. But actual parameters depend on seed. Must run a probe: maximize residual over the box. This is a linear program per neuron (independent), max residual = 0.25 * sum_j max(sum_i W[j,i]*x_i - b[j]) with x_i in [-1,1] → x_i = sign(W[j,i]). Compute with actual seed. Also verify with adversarial probe running kernel.
